ENERGY PERFORMANCE CERTIFICATE REPORT — PORTFOLIO ASSESSMENT 2026

1. Meadow Court Apartments
Meadow Court Apartments has been assessed with a wall U-value of 0.28 W/m2K and a roof U-value of 0.16 W/m2K. Before retrofit works, the measured air permeability of Meadow Court Apartments was 9.5 m3/h/m2. After retrofit works, the measured air permeability of Meadow Court Apartments was 4.2 m3/h/m2. The energy use intensity of Meadow Court Apartments is 95 kWh/m2/yr, and the carbon intensity of Meadow Court Apartments is 18 kgCO2/m2/yr. Meadow Court Apartments has been rated EPC band C.

2. Riverside Depot Warehouse
Riverside Depot Warehouse has a wall U-value of 0.35 W/m2K and a window U-value of 1.6 W/m2K. The measured air permeability of Riverside Depot Warehouse was 12.0 m3/h/m2. The installed boiler at Riverside Depot Warehouse operates at a seasonal efficiency of 78%. Riverside Depot Warehouse has been rated EPC band D.

3. Oak Street Terrace
Oak Street Terrace has a glazing ratio of 22%. The energy use intensity of Oak Street Terrace is 210 kWh/m2/yr, and the carbon intensity of Oak Street Terrace is 46 kgCO2/m2/yr.

4. Pine Hall Community Centre
The installed boiler at Pine Hall Community Centre operates at a seasonal efficiency of 91%.
